provenance: Synthetic offline contract fixtures; format assumptions are labelled. No real provider capture or model calls.
adjustments: Only HTTP/SSE pure-classification cases retained; transport/local preflight/visible-output retry execution belongs to root integration tests.
Diagnostics assert exact allowlisted public sentences or null, never arbitrary response prefixes.
PermissionError is the same-class compatibility alias of PermissionDenied.
Remote payload errors use PayloadTooLarge subclass of BadRequest.
Membership quota fallback is none; all D1 stop signals are persistent global stops.
